🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
Twisted Metal follows John Doe, a delivery driver navigating a dangerous post-apocalyptic wasteland filled with ruthless gangs, deadly vehicles, and unpredictable enemies. Along the way, he encounters Sweet Tooth, a terrifying masked killer with a weaponized ice cream truck, turning an already dangerous journey into a fight for survival.
Packed with explosive car chases, brutal battles, bizarre characters, and dark comedy, the series delivers a chaotic adventure where every road leads to danger and nobody is safe.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
